scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
state: Central / All India (implemented in most States/UTs)
benefits_summary: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover for eligible poor and vulnerable families at empanelled public and private hospitals across India.
coverage_amount_inr: Up to ₹5 lakh per eligible family per year for listed packages (state-wise implementation may vary)

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: Primarily SECC 2011 and other notified categories; no single universal income ceiling
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: Poor and vulnerable households as per SECC and state lists
required_documents: Ration card / family card where applicable

chunks: AB-PMJAY is the national public health insurance scheme covering secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
Coverage is up to ₹5 lakh per eligible family per year for listed treatment packages.
Implemented across most States/UTs, often integrated with state schemes.

department: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
benefits_summary: Dedicated Ayushman card for all Indian citizens aged 70 years and above, enabling cashless secondary and tertiary hospital treatment under AB-PMJAY.
coverage_amount_inr: Up to ₹5 lakh per eligible senior citizen family unit per year under PM-JAY packages

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: No income ceiling for 70+ category
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: All Indian citizens aged 70+ irrespective of income

chunks: Launched in 2024 to cover all Indians aged 70+ under PM-JAY.
Provides a distinct Ayushman card for senior citizens.
Uses the same PM-JAY hospital network and package framework.

department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
state: Central / Selected cities and Government establishments in India
benefits_summary: Comprehensive medical care for eligible Central Government employees, pensioners and dependents, including OPD, medicines, diagnostics and hospitalization under CGHS rules.
coverage_amount_inr: No fixed annual sum insured; governed by CGHS entitlement and approved rates

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: N/A
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: Central Government employees, pensioners and eligible dependents

chunks: CGHS provides comprehensive care rather than a fixed insurance limit.
Eligibility depends on Central Government employment or pension status.
Services are obtained through CGHS facilities and authorized hospitals.

department: Employees' State Insurance Corporation, Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
state: Central / Implemented in 668+ districts across India
benefits_summary: Social security and health insurance for organized-sector employees and their families, covering hospitalization, maternity, disability and dependents' benefits.
coverage_amount_inr: No fixed annual sum insured; benefits as per ESIC rules and wage limits

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: Employees earning up to ₹21,000 per month (₹25,000 for persons with disabilities)
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: Employees in ESIC-covered establishments and their families

key_covered_conditions: Dependents' benefits in case of employment-related death
chunks: ESIC covers organized-sector employees and their families.
Both employer and employee contribute to the scheme.
Now covers 668+ districts across India.

department: National Trust for the Care of Persons with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation and Multiple Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits_summary: Health insurance for persons with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation or Multiple Disabilities, covering hospitalization, OPD, therapy and transport costs.
coverage_amount_inr: Up to ₹1 lakh per year on reimbursement basis

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: No income ceiling
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: Persons with specified disabilities holding valid disability certificate and UDID

chunks: Niramaya covers persons with specified disabilities.
Annual premium is ₹250 for BPL and ₹500 for others.
Enrollment through National Trust or registered disability organizations.

department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
benefits_summary: One-time financial assistance for BPL patients with specified life-threatening diseases receiving treatment in eligible Government hospitals.
coverage_amount_inr: Case-based one-time grant; no universal fixed amount

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: Applicable BPL threshold
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: BPL patients with specified life-threatening diseases

key_covered_conditions: Cancer and other listed serious illnesses
chunks: RAN provides a case-based one-time grant, not annual insurance.
Eligibility requires BPL status and a qualifying life-threatening disease.
Assistance is released to the treating Government hospital.

department: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
benefits_summary: Direct maternity benefit for eligible pregnant women and lactating mothers from specified disadvantaged groups.
coverage_amount_inr: ₹5000 for first living child; ₹6000 for second living child if the second child is a girl, subject to conditions

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: No single universal ceiling; eligible disadvantaged categories apply
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: Eligible pregnant women and lactating mothers

chunks: PMMVY provides maternity assistance through DBT.
Benefits depend on pregnancy registration, ANC, childbirth and immunization milestones.
Identity, bank and maternal-child health records are generally required.

department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
benefits_summary: Free, assured antenatal care on the 9th of every month for all pregnant women at designated government health facilities.
coverage_amount_inr: Free antenatal services; no fixed monetary limit

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: N/A
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: All pregnant women, especially in second and third trimester

key_exclusions: Private facility care outside programme rules
chunks: PMSMA guarantees free antenatal care on the 9th of every month.
Aims to detect high-risk pregnancies early and reduce maternal mortality.
Not an insurance scheme; does not cover hospitalization costs.

department: National Health Mission, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
state: Central / All India; implemented in all States including Tamil Nadu
benefits_summary: Free and no-expense delivery, caesarean section, medicines, diagnostics, blood, diet and transport in public health institutions for eligible pregnant women and sick newborns.
coverage_amount_inr: No fixed monetary limit; free-of-cost entitlement under programme rules

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: N/A for the universal public-facility entitlement, subject to programme rules
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: Pregnant women delivering in public institutions and eligible sick newborns

key_exclusions: Services after the applicable entitlement period
chunks: JSSK provides free delivery and caesarean services in public health institutions.
The programme includes medicines, diagnostics, blood, diet and transport.
It is a Government service guarantee rather than a fixed-sum insurance policy.

department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India; implemented by State NHM
state: Central / All India; implemented in all States including Tamil Nadu
benefits_summary: Safe-motherhood cash assistance programme encouraging institutional delivery among eligible pregnant women under Government rules.
coverage_amount_inr: Amount varies by State, rural or urban location and beneficiary category; no single India-wide amount

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: Eligibility depends on current JSY State and category rules
eligibility_criteria.bpl_or_secc_required: BPL or other notified category may be required
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: Eligible pregnant women, especially poor and vulnerable women
required_documents: BPL or category document where required

chunks: JSY provides cash assistance to encourage institutional delivery.
Eligibility and payment vary by State, residence and beneficiary category.
The programme is a maternity cash benefit, not hospitalization insurance.

department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
state: Central / All India; implemented in all States including Tamil Nadu
benefits_summary: Umbrella public-health mission supporting rural and urban health services, maternal and child health, communicable and non-communicable disease programmes, health-system strengthening and free or subsidized public services.
coverage_amount_inr: Programme-specific; no single insurance amount

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: Varies by programme; many public-health services are not income-restricted
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: Residents using public health services and programme-specific target groups

chunks: NHM is an umbrella mission supporting public healthcare across India.
Benefits and eligibility vary by programme, including maternal, child, communicable and non-communicable disease services.
It is not a single insurance policy and has no universal sum insured.

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefits_summary: Cashless hospitalization insurance for eligible Tamil Nadu resident families at empanelled hospitals, with coverage enhanced to ₹25 lakh per family per year as announced in August 2026.
coverage_amount_inr: Up to ₹25 lakh per eligible family per year (announced August 2026; implementation ongoing)

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: Less than ₹120000 per family per year under existing eligibility documentation
eligibility_criteria.bpl_or_secc_required: No; income and family-card eligibility apply
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: Eligible low-income Tamil Nadu resident families
required_documents: Tamil Nadu family or ration card

chunks: CMCHIS coverage increased from ₹5 lakh to ₹25 lakh per family per year (August 2026 announcement).
Eligibility requires Tamil Nadu residence and the applicable income criterion.
Existing insurance cards remain valid; revised coverage to be implemented soon.

scheme_name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit Scheme (MRMBS)
department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefits_summary: Maternity assistance scheme providing ₹18000 per eligible beneficiary through cash instalments and two nutrition kits, subject to pregnancy registration, antenatal care, childbirth and immunization conditions.
coverage_amount_inr: ₹18000 per eligible beneficiary, including cash and nutrition-kit benefits, subject to current guidelines

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: Poor or eligible pregnant women under current Tamil Nadu guidelines
eligibility_criteria.bpl_or_secc_required: Eligibility-category and income conditions apply; not an insurance scheme
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: Eligible poor pregnant women and mothers

chunks: MRMBS provides ₹18000 maternity assistance through cash and nutrition-kit benefits.
Eligibility depends on pregnancy registration, antenatal care, childbirth and immunization conditions.
PICME, identity, bank and maternal-child health records support payment.

department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefits_summary: Distribution of a newborn care kit to eligible babies delivered in Government health institutions under Tamil Nadu maternal and child-health programmes.
coverage_amount_inr: In-kind benefit; value and contents depend on current Tamil Nadu Government specifications

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: Generally linked to delivery in eligible Government facilities and current State rules
eligibility_criteria.bpl_or_secc_required: Not universally required; facility and State conditions apply
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: Babies born in eligible Tamil Nadu Government health institutions

key_exclusions: Births outside eligible facilities or rules
chunks: Amma Baby Care Kit is an in-kind newborn-care benefit in Tamil Nadu.
Eligibility generally depends on delivery in an eligible Government institution.
Delivery and mother-child health records support distribution.

department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefits_summary: Preventive health-screening initiative providing basic health checks and investigations through public health facilities, especially for adults aged 30 years and above.
coverage_amount_inr: Free or Government-funded screening services; no fixed insurance sum

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: N/A
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: Tamil Nadu residents eligible for public preventive screening

key_exclusions: Specialist treatment outside the screening service
chunks: Amma Arokiya provides preventive screening through Tamil Nadu public facilities.
The programme focuses particularly on adults aged 30 and above.
It is a screening service and not a fixed-sum insurance scheme.

department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefits_summary: Tamil Nadu emergency-care programme providing cashless treatment during the first 48 hours after eligible road-traffic accidents and other notified emergencies, subject to current Government rules and hospital authorization.
coverage_amount_inr: Up to ₹200000 for eligible treatment under the cited revised Tamil Nadu Government provision

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: N/A
eligibility_criteria.bpl_or_secc_required: No; emergency and scheme conditions apply
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: Eligible emergency and accident patients in Tamil Nadu

chunks: Nammai Kaakkum 48 provides cashless emergency treatment during the first 48 hours.
The cited Tamil Nadu Government material reports a revised ceiling of ₹2 lakh.
Emergency and hospital records are used for authorization and settlement.

scheme_name: Nalam 360 – Annual Free Health Check-up for All
department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefits_summary: Annual free health check-up for all Tamil Nadu residents aged 30 years and above, offering 14 basic tests at government health facilities, with plans for home-based diagnostic services in metropolitan areas.
coverage_amount_inr: Free screening services; no fixed insurance amount

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: N/A
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: Tamil Nadu residents aged 30+ using public health facilities

key_exclusions: Specialist treatment outside the screening service
chunks: Announced in August 2026 as part of health department reforms.
Provides 14 basic tests annually at 1,257 government facilities.
Supported by a planned Nalam 360 mobile application and Positive Health Policy.

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Elderly Health Insurance Scheme
department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefits_summary: Free health insurance for Tamil Nadu residents aged 70 years and above, covering super-speciality treatment including cancer care, advanced cardiac surgeries, organ transplants and high-end diagnostics at empanelled government and private hospitals, with no income ceiling.
coverage_amount_inr: No fixed monetary ceiling stated in announcement; covers specified super-speciality packages

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: No income ceiling
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: Tamil Nadu residents aged 70 years and above
required_documents: Scheme enrollment/registration as per official process

key_exclusions: Services not covered under approved packages
chunks: Announced in August 2026 to cover about 38 lakh senior citizens aged 70+.
No income ceiling; free treatment at empanelled government and private hospitals.
Part of broader health announcements including Nalam 360 and policy reforms.

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu New Health Insurance Scheme 2026 (Employees)
department: Finance (Health Insurance) Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefits_summary: Health insurance for Tamil Nadu government employees and eligible family members, providing cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals with basic sum insured of ₹7.50 lakh and up to ₹12 lakh for specified illnesses, effective July 2026 for a five-year block.
coverage_amount_inr: 750000 basic; up to 1200000 for specified illnesses; Corpus Fund up to 1500000 for rare/specified illnesses (employees only)

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: N/A; based on government employment status
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: Government employees, eligible family members, and specified categories such as aided institution staff where adopted
required_documents: Employee code / GPF / TPF / CPS number
Photographs and dependency proofs as per enrollment form

key_covered_conditions: Hospitalization and day-care procedures under approved packages
Super-speciality and critical care at empanelled hospitals
key_exclusions: Non-package and non-empanelled treatment outside rules
chunks: NHIS 2026 effective from 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2031 for employees and pensioners.
Basic cover ₹7.50 lakh; specified illnesses up to ₹12 lakh; employees have Corpus Fund up to ₹15 lakh.
Enrollment automatic via IFHRMS; monthly subscription deducted from salary.

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu New Health Insurance Scheme 2026 (Pensioners)
department: Finance (Health Insurance) Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefits_summary: Health insurance for Tamil Nadu government pensioners, family pensioners and eligible dependents, with basic sum insured of ₹7.50 lakh and up to ₹12 lakh for specified illnesses, effective July 2026 for a five-year block.
coverage_amount_inr: 750000 basic; up to 1200000 for specified illnesses; no Corpus Fund for pensioners

eligibility_criteria.income_limit_per_annum_inr: N/A; based on pension status
eligibility_criteria.target_beneficiaries: State civil, teacher, All India Service and other eligible pensioners and family pensioners drawing pension from Tamil Nadu Consolidated Fund
required_documents: Pension disbursing office and bank details
Photographs and dependency proofs as per enrollment form

key_covered_conditions: Hospitalization and day-care procedures under approved packages
Super-speciality and critical care at empanelled hospitals
key_exclusions: Non-package and non-empanelled treatment outside rules
chunks: NHIS 2026 pensioner component effective 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2031.
Basic cover ₹7.50 lakh; specified illnesses up to ₹12 lakh; no Corpus Fund for pensioners.
Enrollment largely automatic; some categories must submit option form.
